content: Tewi kemɨtiu'irɨwiyarie

Kuu, kwinimieme katinimaiwekaitɨni keyuri hipatɨ yeutari Yawé Kakaɨyari muwarutawewiekai, hikɨ 'uka mɨpaɨ pɨtiuta'iwawiyaxɨ: ―¿Kakaɨyari mɨpaɨ pɨkahainekai xɨari kename xeka'ikwaka naime 'ikwaxi harawerita mieme?
'Uka mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —Tepɨyɨwawe naime 'ikwaxi temɨtikwanikɨ.
Mɨkɨ xeikɨa 'iteɨri 'ikwaxiyari haraweri hixɨapa muwe, tepɨkayɨwawe temitikwanikɨ Kakaɨyari pɨtarahɨawekai kename teka'ikwakakekai 'ikwaxi mɨkɨ 'iteɨritsiemieme, xɨka te'itikwani tepɨkwini.
Kuu 'uka mɨpaɨ kaniutahɨawe: —Tixaɨ xepɨkakwini.
Kakaɨyari katinimaika kepauka xemitikwani mɨkɨ 'ikwaxi, kwinimieme xetemaiwawetɨ xepakɨne, xepɨtemaika tita 'aixɨa mɨti'ane, tita 'axamɨti'ane, Kakaɨyari hepaɨ xepɨ'aneneni.
Hikɨ 'uka mɨkɨ 'ikwaxi witsi'anekame kaniuxeiya kanitihiwe'erieni mitakwanikɨ, timaiwetɨ mayanikɨ. Hikɨ kaneka'inɨni kanitakwani. Kwitɨta yɨkɨna kaniumini mɨkɨta kanitakwani.
'Ana kwitɨ mekananutaneniere yuhutatɨ 'arike mɨpaɨ mepɨtehetima mepɨmamawekai, hikɨ piní xawarikɨ petsera mekaniyutiwewirieni memuyutetewiyakaikɨ.
'Uki yɨ'ɨya hamatɨa mekani'enieni Yawé Kakaɨyari harawerita 'uyeikame taikai 'ekatsie, hikɨ mekaniyuti'awieta memɨmamawekaikɨ 'iteɨritsata harawerita.
Peru Yawé Kakaɨyari 'uki kaniutahɨawe mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ: —¿Hakewa pepeyeika?
'Uki mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Nepɨmatsi'u'eni 'uwa pe'uyeikame nepɨmatsi'utimaka nemɨmawekaikɨ, 'ayumieme nepɨyuti'awietaxɨ.
Hikɨ Kakaɨyari mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —¿Kemɨ'ane mɨpaɨ matiutahɨawixɨ kename pemawekai? Mɨkɨ 'ikwaxi nemɨxemaiwe'erikatsitɨakai xekate'utikwai.
'Uki mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Mɨkɨ 'uka pemɨnetsi'uwitɨtɨa, pɨnetsi'umi nepitakwai.
Hikɨ Yawé Kakaɨyari 'uka mɨpaɨ katiniuta'iwawiya: —'Uka 'aku kepetiuyuri. 'Uka mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Kuu pɨnetiu'irɨwiyaxɨ 'ayumieme 'ikwaxi neputakwai.
Yawé Kakaɨyari 'ayumieme kuu mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe:
Meta 'uka mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe:
'Uki meta mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe:

content.text: mɨkɨ kɨyetsie mieme tsepa mɨpaɨ nematiutahɨawixɨ pemɨka'ikwakakɨ.
haweri mieme peti'uximayatɨ xeikɨa pepɨtikwaka kwiepa mieme, mexi 'ape'uyeikani.

content: 'Uki yu'ɨya 'Ewa pɨtiuterɨwaxɨ, mɨkɨ yunaime nuiwarite wamaama mayanikekaikɨ.
Yawé Kakaɨyari puwarutiwewiri nawi kamixayari 'Arani meta 'ɨyaya, mɨkɨkɨ puwarutikemaritɨa.

Hikɨ Yawé mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: «Hikɨri 'uki meta 'uka tahepaɨ mekani'aneneni, metemaitɨ tita 'aixɨa mɨti'ane tita 'axamɨti'ane, xɨka me'itikwani 'ikwaxi tukari mɨtiyupitɨwa, mepɨyɨwaweni yuheyemekɨ me'ayeyuyuritɨ memuyuhayewanikɨ».
'Ayumieme Yawé Kakaɨyari kaniwaranuyeweiya teɨteri 'Ereni haraweriyarita, kaniwarupitɨani memɨte'uximayakakɨ kwiepa, 'Arani kwiekɨ mutawewiyakɨ.

Waranuyeweiyaka, haraweri 'Ereni tau manatineika hepatsie Kakaɨyari teɨtametemama memayeneniere meta xeime 'ixipara takame naitsarie 'uyuaneme, huye mɨ'ɨwiyanikɨ kɨye tukari tiyupitɨwame hetsɨa meutayune.
